job.title: Litigation Lawyer | 2-6 Year PQE | Specialist litigation firm in the CBD
job.description:
Join a supportive Auckland law firm offering a 2–6 year PQE solicitor rapid career fast-tracking through hands on learning.  You will work on high-value civil disputes and landmark cases alongside leading partners and barristers.
  
The Role & Opportunity
You will work directly with leading litigation partners and will have the opportunity to support senior members of the Bar. Through this hands-on learning environment, you will gain rapid, practical experience drafting pleadings, attending mediations, and preparing for court.

We are open to a range of experience levels. You might be a 2-year solicitor looking to fast-track your development, or a more senior 6-year solicitor bringing solid experience to a high-performing team. Whatever your level, you will enjoy a flat firm structure with top-tier work, minus the usual big-firm rigidity.

Based in a beautiful Auckland CBD office with excellent views, our team culture is genuinely supportive. The central location also makes commuting easy, whether you bike, walk, drive, or take the bus, train, or ferry.
  
What we’re looking for:
  • 2 to 6 years of Post-Qualification Experience (PQE) in litigation.
  • A current New Zealand practising certificate paired with a strong academic record.
  • Commercial acumen and the ability to think both strategically and practically to find client solutions.
  • An enthusiastic and proactive approach, with a genuine eagerness to grow your career within a leading litigation practice.
  • A strong commitment to client service and the confidence to build enduring, value-driven relationships

About the Firm
Our client is a premier, specialist litigation practice handling a significant breadth of work, including some of the most complex matters before the New Zealand Courts.  The firm attracts premium work while deliberately leaving the rigid corporate hierarchy behind.

This is a genuinely flat, down-to-earth environment. There are no layers of administrative hierarchy to hand off the "small work" to; everyone rolls up their sleeves and works as a team. 

You will enjoy being part of a team that boasts the depth of resource required to tackle large, complex, multi-party disputes, alongside the agility and experience to act decisively on whatever comes their way.
  
What Is on Offer
  • Hands-on Mentorship: Direct, daily contact with partners.
  • Elite Portfolio: Immediate exposure to interesting and complex disputes and landmark cases.
  • Authentic Culture: A friendly, down-to-earth, and genuinely supportive workspace that values a practical approach.
  • Remuneration: A highly competitive salary package tailored specifically to your experience.

How to Apply
Click on “Apply now” or contact us directly for more information about this opportunity. Please send your CV and academic transcript to sarah@legalpersonnel.co.nz or text/call 02102318312

We will be reviewing suitable applications as they are received.
